content:
## Request Context
- **What was requested**: Build Telemetry Layer A3 from SPEC-20260606-211429 (approved + Steward-cleared). Two local honesty metrics: value-vs-subscription leverage + estimate cross-check. AFK autonomous run; STOP before education gate + before commit.
- **Files/scope**: NEW src/telemetry/value.py (pure), scripts/telemetry/analyze_value.py (transport/CLI), config/subscription.yaml.example + .gitignore, tests in tests/test_telemetry.py, ADR-0020 A3 note, memory/projects/_self.md Solution Path. Reuse A1 (pricing/cost/load_cost_rows/build_cost_report) + itu._ helpers.
- **Developer-stated motivation**: Understand-your-AI-use; data foundation for the north-star Layer B dashboard. Subscription+individual account ⇒ billing APIs out; local value+cross-check.
- **Explicit constraints**: 9 binding Steward+review conditions — compute-don't-store regression guard (prefer no new table); leverage time-basis labelling (per-month AND cumulative); typed honest absence (available:bool + divergence_pct None, never 0.0); OTel ingest hardened (fixed path + containment + size cap + tolerant reader + parameterized SQL + token inputs only); leverage takes CostReport param; negative/malformed fee -> not-configured; public-clean __init__, reuse-not-promote itu._ helpers; circular-import test; known-broken note in _self.md not the ledger table. Scope A3 ONLY. Quality gate 7/7, coverage >=80%.

Build plan (5 tasks):
T1 — src/telemetry/value.py (pure): SubscriptionFee/LeverageResult/IndependentEstimate/DivergenceResult dataclasses; load_subscription_fee (config loader, _coerce_rate discipline, neg/zero/malformed -> not-configured); leverage(report: CostReport, fee: SubscriptionFee|None) -> LeverageResult (time-basis labelled, per-month + cumulative); cross_check(a1_estimate, independent: IndependentEstimate|None) -> DivergenceResult (typed absence, div-by-zero guard, flaw-class). [checkpoint: new module -> architecture + qa]
T2 — scripts/telemetry/analyze_value.py (transport/CLI): load A1 CostReport from stored discussion_model_tokens via load_cost_rows/build_cost_report; attribution baseline = un-windowed per-model aggregation from itu._collect_messages priced with same PricingTable; OTel ingest from fixed data/otel_export.jsonl (itu._is_inside_projects_root + size cap + tolerant reader); print both metrics w/ honesty caveats. [checkpoint: new module + external-source ingest -> security + architecture]
T3 — config/subscription.yaml.example (committed placeholder) + .gitignore (config/subscription.yaml) + quality_gate staged-fee warning. [scaffolding/config — checkpoint exempt]
T4 — ADR-0020 A3 implementation note (local source, superseded Cost-API rationale, two metrics, compute-don't-store, A3 as 3rd consumer of itu._ helpers) + memory/projects/_self.md Solution Path for the superseded Cost-API decision. [docs — exempt]
T5 — tests/test_telemetry.py A3 tests: fee unset/zero/neg/epsilon/malformed; leverage time-basis; cross-check absence(available False, divergence_pct None)/identical/zero-denominator/partial-scope; compute-don't-store @pytest.mark.regression guard; circular-import collection-time import. [tests — exempt]

T1 checkpoint (new module src/telemetry/value.py): APPROVE (0.93). All 5 binding conditions structurally satisfied: cond-5 leverage takes CostReport param (no forked cost path); cond-1 cumulative + per_month are separate named fields + window_months carried; cond-3 typed None absence + zero-denominator guard; cond-2 IndependentEstimate is a single frozen dataclass (no registry); cond-6 _coerce_fee rejects zero/negative/unparseable like _coerce_rate. Boundary correct (depends inward on cost.py only; __init__ re-exports public surface, no leak of _coerce_fee/parse_subscription_fee). LOW note: LeverageResult.reason was overloaded (non-empty when configured but per-month absent) — consumers can't key reason!='' as 'not configured'.

T1 checkpoint (new module src/telemetry/value.py): REVISE (0.90). 2 blocking + 1 medium. Issue 1 (blocking): cross_check returned available=True with divergence_pct=None when independent cost <=0.0 — self-contradictory vs the typed-absence contract (cond-3 says zero-denominator -> available=False/divergence_pct=None). Issue 2 (blocking): no NaN guard — a non-finite report.total_cost_usd would yield leverage_cumulative=nan (configured=True) and available=True/delta=nan silently. Issue 3 (medium): LeverageResult.reason overloaded for the configured-but-no-window case (same as arch's LOW note). Strengths: _coerce_fee rejects zero/neg; identical-estimates -> direction None; parse_subscription_fee non-dict guard; missing-file normal.

T1 checkpoint ROUND 2: APPROVE (0.97). All 3 Round-1 findings resolved. Finding1: usable_indep gate routes every zero/negative/non-finite independent cost into the absent block — no path reaches delta without a strictly-positive finite denominator. Finding2: math.isfinite gates on total (leverage) + our + indep (cross_check); every non-finite input -> honest-absence. Finding3: reason populated only on configured=False; per-month advisory moved to note; DivergenceResult carries only reason. Surface deterministic, all absence cases (present=False / cost None / 0.0 / nan / our=nan) distinct+labelled+independently testable to >=98%.

T2 checkpoint (scripts/telemetry/analyze_value.py, new module + external ingest): APPROVE (0.93). OTel ingest hardened on all 4 binding conditions: _is_within(path, DATA_DIR) symlink-safe containment (mirrors _is_inside_projects_root); OTEL_MAX_BYTES 100MB size cap; tolerant JSONL reader (JSONDecodeError/non-dict skip); numeric+bool coercion of OTel values; saw_cost gate -> present=False (honest absence, no spurious zero-dollar). No SQL writes; no network; no credential; nothing persisted. LOW (fixed in-session): existence probe (path.exists/is_file) preceded the containment check, leaking an existence oracle on a user-supplied --otel path -> reordered containment FIRST.

T2 checkpoint (scripts/telemetry/analyze_value.py): APPROVE (0.96). Boundary discipline correct: transport assembles+prints only, no arithmetic beyond _window_months (feeds a param into value.leverage, not cost). Cond-5 satisfied: _load_a1_report wraps load_cost_rows+build_cost_report (identical A1 path, no fork). Attribution-baseline identity holds at CODE level: _baseline_estimate builds ModelTokenRow from raw messages with the SAME PricingTable + build_cost_report, no itu._attribute, no window filter -> 'same pricing, differs only in attribution' true; scope_coverage_pct=100/flaw_class=ATTRIBUTION correct. IndependentEstimate seam used for both sources via two cross_check calls, no registry. Re-parse handled correctly (single _collect_messages reused, no second scan). Absence-path DivergenceResult carries flaw_class=None (right — divergence not attributable when unavailable). No expensive-to-fix structural risk.

Task 3 (config/subscription.yaml.example + .gitignore + quality_gate staged-fee advisory): checkpoint bypass — scaffolding/config + an advisory-only gate check that mirrors the existing check_build_status_freshness pattern (uses _warn, returns True, NOT appended to results, cannot fail the gate). Primary control = .gitignore (config/subscription.yaml + data/otel_export.jsonl) + committed .example placeholder (monthly_fee_usd 0.00). Security F2 satisfied: real fee can't be accidentally committed; advisory backstop warns if force-staged.

Task 4 (ADR-0020 A3 implementation note + memory/projects/_self.md Solution Path): checkpoint bypass — documentation. ADR note records: Cost-API superseded (individual/subscription), compute-don't-store reaffirmed (no A3 table), two pinned IndependentEstimate sources, A3 as 3rd consumer of itu._ helpers + live 66/244 figures. _self.md Solution Path records the no-billing-API known-broken approach (in Solution Paths, NOT the ledger table).

Build complete: 5 tasks, 2 checkpoints fired (T1 value.py, T2 analyze_value.py), 0 unresolved concerns. T1: architecture APPROVE 0.93; qa REVISE 0.90 -> 2 blocking (zero/negative independent cost wrongly available=True; missing NaN guard) + 1 medium (reason overloaded) all FIXED -> qa Round 2 APPROVE 0.97. T2: security APPROVE 0.93 (1 LOW: existence-oracle before containment -> reordered) + architecture APPROVE 0.96. Tests: 109 passed (incl. +44 A3 tests); src/telemetry/value.py 100% cov, scripts/telemetry/analyze_value.py 89%; quality gate 7/7; regression ledger 15 guards (+compute-don't-store guard). LIVE smoke on real data: A1 $666.26/100% coverage; attribution baseline $2,244.53 -> our estimate 70% lower => framework discussions account for ~30% of total project AI spend (honest coverage signal); OTel pricing cross-check honestly unavailable (no export file). Compute-don't-store proven by regression test (read-only, no table). Reflection: qa T1 REVISE reflection deferred (non-blocking) — substance captured in the round-1/round-2 critique turns. NEXT: /review, then education gate (interactive, developer), then commit. NO push beyond the already-pushed plan.
